r.통화: Central African CFA franc · 100 XAF = 225 won
r.경제 체제: Oil and gas · wealth concentrated in few hands
r.Consumer price level: 46% of the US level (2024, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Steel products 45%, Cars 14%, Machinery, computers 11%, Tobacco 10% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Crude oil 54%, Natural gas (LNG, LPG) 45% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: The same president has been in power since 1979.

t.rel: The only African country with Spanish as an official language. An oil exporter.
t.know: In 2026 it moved its capital from Malabo on Bioko island to Ciudad de la Paz on the mainland.
t.etext: Oil and gas lifted income per person into Africa's top tier, but the wealth is concentrated in a few hands. As output declines, the economy is shrinking.
